description: RGC compiled-language support: syntax highlighting, build/run/test commands, and a bundled LSP client for the RGC analyzer over stdio.
command.build.title: Build Current File
command.run.title: Run Current File
command.test.title: Test Current File
command.restart.title: Restart Language Server
config.title: RGC
config.compilerPath.description: Path to the `rgc` compiler executable used by the build/run/test commands. Defaults to `rgc` on `PATH`.
config.serverPath.description: Path to the RGC analyzer executable. Defaults to `rgc-analyzer`: the bundled `server/rgc-analyzer` is used when the extension ships one, otherwise `rgc-analyzer` is looked up on `PATH`.
config.serverArgs.description: Command-line arguments passed to the RGC analyzer. Empty by default; the analyzer always speaks LSP over stdio.
